title: Cross-stitch script ampersand
subtitle: A large decorative ampersand with floral fill detail on 14-count white Aida
excerpt: A single large script-style ampersand approximately 70 by 80 stitches, worked in two coordinating colours on 14-count white Aida and finished at roughly 12 by 14 cm. Small flowers and leaves fill the inner curves of the letter shape, converting the letterform into a botanical composition.
sourceNotes: Original design. Decorative ampersand typography is a well-established format in modern cross-stitch and hand-lettering design. The floral fill approach for letterforms is documented in UK craft publishing from the 2010s.

content.text: The ampersand outline is worked in back-stitch; the thick strokes of the letterform are filled with cross-stitch. The inner loop of the ampersand contains a small arrangement of flowers and leaves worked at a finer scale than the surrounding letter.

items.label: Thread
items.value: DMC 3750 (very dark antique blue) — for letter strokes, 3721 (dark shell pink), 3689 (light mauve), 368 (light pistachio), 320 (medium pistachio), 972 (yellow) — for inner flowers

content.text: Outline the ampersand shape in back-stitch first.
Work the full outer and inner outlines of the script ampersand in two strands of 3750. The outline defines where the cross-stitch fill will go and makes the thick strokes easier to fill correctly.
Fill the cross-stitch fill sections (the thick parts of the script letterform) in 3750 within the back-stitch outline.

In the enclosed inner loop of the ampersand, work three small flowers in 3721 and 3689 with small leaves in 368 and a French knot flower centre in 972. The flowers sit freely within the letter curve rather than aligning to a separate grid.
Add trailing leaf or vine detail.
Extend a small vine of 320 back-stitch and 368 leaf pairs below the base of the letterform to ground the composition and fill the lower quarter of the fabric.
Frame in a 15 × 18 cm mount or display in a 15 cm round hoop. The design also pairs well as one of a set with a matching letter monogram (see the block letter monogram tutorial).
